newsitem.title: USA: Entergy Arkansas nuke returns to service.
newsitem.headline: Entergy Arkansas nuke returns to service.

text.p: Entergy Corp's 836 megawatt (MW) Arkansas nuclear unit 1, shut since September 12 for maintenance and refueling, reconnected to the electricity grid late Thursday, the company said Friday.
"It should be back to 100 percent within a couple days," said company spokesman Terry Young.
The Russellville, Ark., unit was originally expected to restart October 20, but it was delayed following an insulation fire last Thursday.
The adjacent unit, with a generating capacity of 858 MW, has been operating at full power for 323 consecutive days, Young added.
Entergy's 1,173 MW Grand Gulf nuclear unit 1 in Port Gibson, Miss., shut October 19 for maintenance, is expected to restart around November 21.
